operator_instruction_verbatim: So for the initial part of a mercenaries round, typically what the player needs to be doing is running from Checkpoint to Checkpoint, grabbing the time bonuses and dispatching enough enemies to get to the time bonuses and navigating to each time bonus while dropping lines. And then after grabbing all the time bonuses, that's when the match truly begins and they can begin to make a stand and start trying to defend themselves while running around and fighting through the level and going after threats and dealing with threats themselves. In Resident Evil Five, the only way to grab a time bonus is to walk up to it and melee it. Same thing with Resident Evil Six. You can't shoot it from a distance. You have to walk up to it and dispatch the time bonus physically.

phases.name: opening
phases.objective: run checkpoint to checkpoint; dispatch enough enemies to reach each time bonus; navigate to each time bonus while dropping lines
bot_requirements: dispatch enemies blocking the path to each time bonus
drop lines while navigating to time bonuses
walk up to each time bonus and melee it (ranged acquisition invalid)

phases.name: match
phases.objective: make a stand, defend, fight through the level, go after and deal with threats

mapping.hunt_time_bonuses: BONUS_HUNT (line 116) keeps the bot going for time bonuses taken at the '□ Time bonus' hourglass prompt
mapping.walk_up_and_melee_acquisition: BONUS_TAKE=140.0 (line 118) closes to face it; BONUS_PUNCH_R/BONUS_PUNCH_S (line 120) taps square blindly to punch (melee) it; _take performs the walk-up-melee grab; no ranged acquisition path exists
mapping.gather_checkpoint_to_checkpoint: phase gather_time / break_for_time (PHASE_CODE line 158; line 3317 sets break_for_time if self.stood else gather_time) routes the bot checkpoint to checkpoint while dropping lines (route walk, line 2000)
mapping.dispatch_enemies_blocking_the_path: in _bonus, when not at the bonus and no clearance lease and any live threat: set phase to 'fight' to clear the path before proceeding (line 3240-3242)
mapping.stand_begins_after_all_bonuses: self.stood flips True and phase becomes 'stand' once the reachable bonuses are gathered (lines 1507, 2827-2828): the match-truly-begins transition
